function: Learned power allocation and subchannel association for the UAV-IoT uplink and the MBS-UE downlink; the spectrum partitioning factor is found by exhaustive or line search, not learned (p. 7).
system: Single-antenna IoT devices and UEs; MBS and UAV antennas not stated; one MBS, V UAVs at 50 m; 2 GHz carrier, 20 MHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: Fully connected DNNs (7 hidden FC-BN-ReLU blocks, softmax output); supervised (labels from exhaustive search or analytical solution) and unsupervised (loss from the objective); offline training (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: 10^5 channel-gain samples (70k train, 20k validation, 10k test); distance path loss, unit-mean exponential fading, probabilistic LoS air-to-ground path loss; no public data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Train: 1 km radius, fading mean 1, path-loss exponent 3.7 (MBS-UE tier). Unseen test: 500/800 m radius, fading means 1.1-5, exponent 4, no retraining (p. 12).
baselines: Non-learned only: exhaustive search, ABA (own BCD-SCA optimization), uniform power with optimal subchannels, random allocation, MQGI/MQGU with Hungarian and water-filling; no earlier learned method (pp. 9-11).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bits/s/Hz) of UEs, transmission delay (s) of IoT devices, weighted objective, CDFs, computation time, training time (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Measured computation time versus number of users for exhaustive search, ABA and LBA (Fig. 10) on an Intel i7-7700HQ; total training time 124-1154 s (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 9: "characterized by a unit mean exponential distribution"; custom simulator with distance-dependent path loss, the G2A path-loss formula only is attributed to 3GPP TR 36.828 (p. 4); no TR 38.901/38.811, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "different system configurations without any further retraining"; trained at 1 km radius, fading mean 1, path-loss exponent 3.7 and tested at 500/800 m, fading means 1.1 to 5, exponent 4 (Table II).
q3_support: p. 11: "compared with two benchmark methods"; these are uniform power with optimal subchannels and random allocation, both non-learned; no earlier learned method or standard learning algorithm is compared, and supervised versus unsupervised LBA are variants of the same method.
q4_support: p. 12: "computation time was recorded using an Intel Core i7-7700HQ"; measured runtime of exhaustive search, ABA and LBA versus number of users (Fig. 10), and training time in Table III (p. 13).
q5_support: p. 9: "channel gain samples via simulation"; data generated with the authors' own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 6: learned control of transmit power and subchannel association in an aerial (UAV-IoT) link, plus a terrestrial MBS-UE tier, and the rules admit single-antenna NTN links (Step 1, items 4 and 6). The spectrum partitioning factor beta is found by exhaustive or line search (p. 7, Remark 2), although pp. 3 and 10 say the LBA also approximates it. q1 = 0: 3GPP TR 36.828 [26] gives only the path-loss formula (p. 4) and TR 36.777 [38] and TR 36.873 [39] are cited among sources of parameters (p. 9); reviewer may confirm.
